title: ConicSpawn
description: A blazing-fast, lightweight spawn plugin with advanced optimization features.
body:
# 🌀 ConicSpawn – Fast, Light, and Optimized

**ConicSpawn** is an advanced yet ultra-lightweight spawn management plugin built for high performance and flexibility.  
It focuses on delivering **fast teleports, minimal server load, and fully customizable settings** — without the bloat.  
Whether you run a small survival world or a large-scale multiplayer network, ConicSpawn ensures a smooth experience for your players.

#### **Read** [<u>**Documents Here**</u>](https://github.com/SwarajDev5/ConicSpawn)
---

## ✨ Features
- ⚡ **Built-in Optimization** - Built-in Optimization (``Ram Cleaner``)
- 🔊 **Customizable sounds** for countdown and teleport events.
- 🛡️ **Teleport safety options** – cancel teleport if the player moves or takes damage.
- 🎯 `/spawn`, `/setspawn`, and `/spawn <player>` *(admin only)* for precise control.
- 🌟 **First join, join, leave, and respawn-at-spawn** events *(toggleable in config)*.
- 🧹 Built-in **Garbage Collector** to clear unused caches and keep memory clean.
- 🎨 100% **configurable** through `config.yml` & `messages.yml` with placeholders.
- 🛠 Optional **teleport commands** to execute after spawn (e.g., giving items, sending messages).

---

## ⚙ Configuration & Customization
Every feature in ConicSpawn is **toggleable** and can be fine-tuned in the configuration files.  
From message formats and sounds to teleport timings and safety rules — it’s all under your control.

**Supported Placeholders in Messages:**
- `{prefix}` – Uses the prefix defined in `messages.yml`
- `{seconds}` – Countdown time left
- `{spawnlocation}` – Coordinates of the spawn
- `{player}` – Player’s name

---

## 📜 Permissions
- ``conicspawn.admin`` – Access to `/setspawn` and `/spawn <player>`.
- ``conicspawn.spawn`` – Allows using `/spawn`.

---

## 📢 Support & Feedback
If you encounter issues, find bugs, or want to suggest features, join our community:  
[**Report Bugs**](https://discord.gg/JvVv7wHQc7)
[**Support**](https://github.com/SwarajDev5/ConicSpawn)

---

💡 **Why ConicSpawn?**  
Other spawn plugins are often bloated with unused features. ConicSpawn is designed to be **lean, fast, and optimized**, while still giving you powerful customization options.
